subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 5
body:
Rev 5: one more test, no code change. 309 checks. New: the exact libvcodecdrv.so QueryCapability() sequence against the virtual devinfo file -- open, a single read(fd, buf, 0x194) returns 404 (the property is 884 bytes so the kernel read would truncate the same way), and the eFuse word at buf+0x10 is 0x80000000. This is the real caller pattern (vendor 0x7626e/0x778fa/0x77f9c), not a synthetic one.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (TSan -O1)

Everything else from rev 2-4 stands. No V33 findings are open on the board; V30-s F15 (not mine) has a concrete patch proposal from me.
